title: Marked Poisson Limit Experiments for Rare Exponentially Tilted Exposure Interventions
banked_reason: D-0.5 proposal NO-PASS: exhausted fixed-benchmark and observed weak-channel angles at enforced field floor; independent MAIN validity confirms no bounded faithful field-tier repair. Proposal exhaustion, not mathematical refutation.
gap_reasons: The headline calibrates constants for a newly manufactured fixed benchmark, without a rate paired with a minimax lower bound, a strict improvement over a named published bound, a first bound for a named existing method, efficiency attainment, or a coverage/limit-law frontier advance.

The exact n-dependent two-component slab density is load-bearing yet its justification establishes only a synthetic benchmark, not plausible applicability to the advertised political-advertising setting.

Independent MAIN validity confirmed proposal exhaustion with no bounded faithful repair, not mathematical refutation. tldr: An exponential advertising shift changes a contribution mean through conditional exposure normalizers. In the public balanced two-component benchmark, repeated relevant exposures occur at finite birthday intensity despite a diverging total number of relevant records. The technical note asks which complete-record information survives, derives a finite marked Poisson experiment with its selection compensator, and calibrates the resulting squared-risk and honest connected-length constants. Both experiment directions, exact deterministic-array minimax reduction, arbitrary-precision decision certificates and intervals honest at every even finite sample size are required. The scientific claim is confined to this incremental fixed-family instance.
gap: The delivered balanced birthday and finite-profile notes already provide continuum risk calibration and original-record reconstruction. Their rare encounter selection is parameter free or their discarded conditional law is exactly ancillary. The submitted exposure family instead changes selection with the concealed density amplitude.
fill: The result would verify compensated full-record sufficiency, provide public two-way simulation errors, and assemble certified decision-limit attainment. Generic Poisson, mixture, reconstruction and minimax optimization mechanisms receive prior credit.
